entry.title: How to review transfer history for an intra-company-code asset transfer (ABUML / F9302) - which App
entry.content:
Ref #315

System: SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition
Topic: Asset Accounting (FI-AA) - intra-company-code asset transfer

We perform intra-company-code asset transfers (e.g. from Asset A to Asset B)
using the following apps:

- Post Transfer - Within Company Code (ABUML) [current app]
- Post Asset Transfer (New Version) (F9302) [successor app, as of 2608,
business transaction type RA30 for transfer within company code]

Afterwards we would like to review the transfer history - ideally a list that
shows, per transfer, the posting date, the sending asset, the receiving asset
and the transferred amount, like this:

Posting Date | Transferred From | Transferred To | Amount
2026/07/24 | Asset A | Asset B | 100 USD

Questions:

1. Which app should be used to display this transfer history?
Is there a standard app that shows the sending and receiving asset side by
side in a single line, or do we need to read the sender and receiver
postings separately and match them by document number?

2. What are the exact steps in that app (selection criteria, filters, columns
to add) to obtain the above information?

3. Does the answer differ depending on whether the transfer was posted with
ABUML or with the successor app F9302? The 2608 What's New notes that the
separation of sender and receiver transaction line items is clearer in
F9302 - does this change how the transfer history can be displayed or
reported?

4. If no standard app provides this, is there a recommended CDS view or
analytical query that can be used instead?

Any pointer to the relevant SAP Help Portal documentation would be appreciated.

entry.title: How to get the result of PROOFOFDELIVERYREQUEST_IN
entry.content:
Hi,

PROOFOFDELIVERYREQUEST_IN is an asynchronous inbound service. Calling this asynchronous interface does not return real-time messages, nor is there a way to query whether the execution was successful or the specific reasons for failure.

entry.title: Data Extension for Portugal Digitally Signed Billing Form (SIPT_CI_SDBIL) in S/4HANA Public Cloud
entry.content:
Hi SAP Experts,

I am trying to extend the data source used by the Portugal digitally signed billing form in SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud.

I came across the following SAP Community post:
https://community.sap.com/t5/technology-q-a/data-extension-form-for-digitally-signed-billing-documents-portugal/qaq-p/13703897

which refers to the SAP Help documentation:
https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_S4HANA_CLOUD/a376cd9ea00d476b96f18dea1247e6a5/688e84d13bce41808aed7af255924a94.html?locale=en-US&version=2408.500

Following the documentation, we have already:

  • Extended the data source FDP_V3_BD_STANDARD_GLO_GEN_SRV with our custom fields.

  • Implemented custom logic using the extension points:

    • SD_BIL_PRINT_STANDARD_HEAD

    • SD_BIL_PRINT_STANDARD_ITEM
      to populate these custom fields.

We also created a copy of the standard Portugal template SIPT_CI_SDBIL named YY1_SIPT_CI_SDBIL.

However, the copied template is based on the data source FDP_V3_BD_STANDARD_GLO_PT, and none of our custom fields are available in this data source. As a result, they cannot be used in the Adobe form.

My questions are:

  1. Is FDP_V3_BD_STANDARD_GLO_PT extensible in SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud?

  2. Is there any supported way to make the custom fields added to FDP_V3_BD_STANDARD_GLO_GEN_SRV available in FDP_V3_BD_STANDARD_GLO_PT?

  3. Is there any additional configuration or extensibility step required for localization forms such as SIPT_CI_SDBIL?

  4. Or is this currently a product limitation, meaning custom fields cannot be exposed to the Portugal digitally signed billing form?

Any guidance or confirmation from SAP or anyone who has implemented this successfully would be greatly appreciated.

Thank you.

Rohit Deshmukh

#SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition Extensibility, #Form for Digitally Signed Billing Documents (Portugal), #Portugal billing form

entry.title: Is intercompany subcontracting supported in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition?
entry.content:
Is intercompany subcontracting supported in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition? If so please ping me the steps or share any relevant documents?

Company A receives a customer purchase order. Based on this, Company A creates a sales order and simultaneously generates a third-party intercompany purchase order to Company B. This intercompany purchase order automatically creates a corresponding intercompany sales order in Company B.

Company B acts as the central procurement organization and coordinates fulfillment across the group companies. Upon receiving the intercompany sales order for Product 1234, Company B creates an intercompany subcontracting purchase order to Company C, which is responsible for manufacturing the finished product.

In addition, Company B procures the required raw materials from Company D by creating a subcontracting purchase order with the ship-to location specified as Company C. Company D then directly ships the raw materials to Company C and invoices Company B for the supplied materials.

Company C receives the raw materials against the subcontracting purchase order issued by Company B, where Company C is maintained as the ship-to party. Company C subsequently uses the received raw materials in a production process to manufacture Product 1234 through a production order.

After completion of the production order, the finished product should not be returned to Company B. Instead, it must be shipped directly from Company C to the final ship-to customer location specified in the subcontracting purchase order created by Company B.

The requirement is to understand how this end-to-end business process can be implemented in SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud, including the detailed process flow, document flow, intercompany transactions, subcontracting process, direct material shipment from Company D to Company C, manufacturing at Company C, and direct customer delivery from Company C to the final ship-to location. In this scenario, Companies A, B, and C are related intercompany entities within the same corporate group.

entry.title: Sorting by Storage Location in "Schedule Delivery Creation for Sales Orders"
entry.content:
Hello experts,

We have a customer on S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition with the following setup and requirement.

Current setup

  • An application job based on the template Schedule Delivery Creation for Sales Orders runs every 30 minutes and creates outbound deliveries.
  • On delivery creation, the output type DELIVERY_NOTE_ORIG_AR (custom form, channel Print) is determined with dispatch time Immediately and printed directly.

Requirement
All printouts of a job run should still be printed, but sorted by storage location (of the delivery items) before printing. Today someone has to sort the printed stack manually.

What we found so far

  • According to this post  the job processes the due list sorted by shipping point and sales order number, and there is no parameter to change the sort order.

Options we are considering

  1. Multi-step job: one step per storage location, using the Storage Location parameter of the job. This gives grouping without development, but may split deliveries, and print order in the queue is not guaranteed.
  2. Scheduled dispatch + custom ABAP Cloud job: set dispatch time to Scheduled, then have a custom application job collect the pending documents, sort them, render one combined PDF and send it to the print queue.

Questions

  1. Is there any standard way (setting, job template, output job parameter) to control the print sequence of scheduled outputs, e.g. by storage location?
  2. Is there a released API or CDS view in the current release to read output items together with their business document (delivery number) and retrieve the rendered PDF? We saw C_OutputRequestItemDEX mentioned, but also that it may not be released for cloud development.
  3. Has anyone implemented a similar "sorted collective printout" in Public Cloud, and which approach worked best?

Thank you in advance for any hints or experience!

entry.content:

entry.title: Alternative Approach for Mass Upload of Recurring Journal Entry Templates in SAP S/4HANA Public Clou
entry.content:
Hello Experts,

I am looking for guidance on a requirement in SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud related to the creation of recurring journal entries at scale.

Business Requirement

We need to mass create/upload a large number of recurring journal entry templates in the system. The objective is to avoid manual creation of each recurring journal entry through the Fiori application Manage Recurring Journal Entries app (F1598)  due to the high volume involved.

After reviewing the available standard applications and APIs, we have encountered the following limitations:

  1. The Manage Recurring Journal Entries Fiori application does not appear to provide any standard Excel upload / mass upload capability for creating recurring journal entries.

  2. The application is based on the OData service/API: FAC_RECURRING_ACCOUNTING_DOC_SRV However, this service appears to be an unreleased API and therefore cannot be consumed for custom development or integrations in SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud, where only released APIs are supported.


Could the community please suggest a supported approach in SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud for:

A. Mass creation of recurring journal entries

B. Mass upload of recurring journal entry templates

C. Available released APIs, migration objects, or public-cloud-compliant integration options

D. Recommended best practices followed by other customers facing similar requirements

Has anyone successfully implemented a scalable solution for this scenario in SAP Public Cloud?Any guidance, recommendations, or alternative approaches would be greatly appreciated.

Thank you in advance for your support.

entry.title: Manage Purchase Orders: custom item field visibility via MM_PUR_S4_PO_FLDCNTRL_SIMPLE
entry.content:
Hello experts,

System: SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition
App: Manage Purchase Orders (F0842A)

Requirement:
A custom checkbox on the product master ("Trade Fields Mandatory") controls
4 custom PO item fields (business context Procurement: Purchasing Document Item).
- Indicator = Yes -> fields visible and mandatory
- Indicator = No -> fields hidden

Implementation (Custom Logic):
- MM_PUR_S4_PO_FLDCNTRL_SIMPLE: reads the indicator from I_Product for
purchaseorderitem-material and sets fieldstatus '+' or '-' for the 4 fields
- MM_PUR_S4_PO_MODIFY_ITEM: clears the fields when indicator = No
- BD_MMPUR_FINAL_CHECK_PO: blocks saving when indicator = Yes and fields are empty

Issue:
1. PO with item 10 (product A, indicator Yes) and item 20 (product B, indicator No):
the item object page keeps the visibility of the previously displayed item.
2. Changing the material of an existing item (B -> A or A -> B): the fields keep
the visibility of the old material.
3. Browser refresh (F5 / Ctrl+F5) does not correct it. Only after opening
Adapt UI and refreshing is the correct visibility shown.

Checks done:
- BAdI returns the correct field status per item (verified)
- Only one published implementation per BAdI
- Product saved (not in draft) before testing
- Tested with new PO drafts after clearing browser cache
- UI adaptation version created and activated

Field control code (simplified):

LOOP AT fieldselection_table ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs>).
IF to_upper( <fs>-field ) CS 'YY1_TRADEPROGRAM_PDI' " + 3 more fields
<fs>-fieldstatus = lv_status. " '+' or '-'
ENDIF.
ENDLOOP.

Questions:
1. Is this a known limitation of Manage Purchase Orders, i.e. dynamic field
control for custom item fields is not re-evaluated per item or after a
material change?
2. Is there a recommended way (side effect, setting or other BAdI) to force
the item page to re-apply the field control?
3. Has anyone implemented product-dependent visibility of custom PO item
fields successfully in Public Cloud?

Screenshots attached.
Thank you!
